cases.question: Which shipper charged the most freight in total?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT s.CompanyName, SUM(o.Freight) AS f FROM Orders o JOIN Shippers s ON o.ShipVia = s.ShipperID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY f DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the smallest freight charge on any order?
Which category has the fewest products?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which country were the fewest orders shipped to?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT ShipCountry, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n ASC LIMIT 1
